history.headline: Volume has ramped nearly 60% over the prior block while easy-run HR sits meaningfully lower on comparable efforts.
watch_items: Watch whether easy pace at the same low HR starts drifting quicker — that would firm the economy interpretation beyond the HR drop alone.

Keep strength frequency from sliding further as running volume stays high through the pre-event weeks.

history.headline: Today's faster tempo effort sat at a notably lower HR than a comparable hard run ten days ago.
watch_items: Whether loaded, consecutive-day efforts appear in the coming weeks — that pack-carrying durability is the gap closest to the event demand.
Whether today's lower HR at faster paces holds up across repeated tempo sessions rather than a single occurrence.
Sleep scores have been erratic and mostly low this week; worth noting if that coincides with any flattening in the HR trend, though the data stream is still too new to act on.

Whether per-run elevation begins climbing to rehearse the sustained up- and downhill of the border mountain section.
